raw_review_excerpt:
Phase 1 is narrow (doc + guardrail + fork-marker only), safely scoped, and has concrete validation steps and an explicit approval gate before any installer or propagation work. The plan is well-grounded in peer-reviewed research with specific SHAs, branches, and rollback anchors. No freeze blockers found. Two WARNs for later-phase verification readiness and one NOTE on missing mid-plan approval gates. Verdict: Sound-with-issues.

Issues:
- 1. [WARN] Later-phase verify commands reference test files that may not exist
- 2. [NOTE] Phases 3-6 lack explicit approval gates
closure_verification: No prior round to verify. This is round 1/3.

rubric_cards.title: Claim Anchoring
rubric_cards.claim: Plan references specific files, branches, SHAs, test files, and upstream behavior as the basis for phased implementation.
rubric_cards.evidence: Verified: oss-fork-manager.json exists with schema_version 1 (line 28). mase-install-fork.sh, mase-gsd-install-inventory.sh, mase-minimal-profile.cjs all exist with matching behavior descriptions. install-profiles.cjs confirms mase-minimal profile and composition model. AGENTS.md and mase-fork-operating-model.md exist and match plan description. Research doc has peer-review sidecar and follow-up verification table. Test files: mase-gsd-fork-scripts.test.cjs, codex-config.test.cjs, agent-install-validation.test.cjs, bug-3357 test exist. install.test.cjs, install-minimal-hooks.test.cjs, graphify-auto-update.test.cjs do NOT exist on current branch. Rollback tag and named ref SHAs claimed in research as verified but not re-verified here (no git tool access).
rubric_cards.disposition: Partial — Phase 1 claims are well-anchored; some later-phase test file references are unverified on the target branch.

issues.title: Later-phase verify commands reference test files that may not exist
issues.details: Phase 2 references tests/install.test.cjs, Phase 3 references tests/install-minimal-hooks.test.cjs, and Phase 4 references tests/graphify-auto-update.test.cjs. None of these exist on the current branch (mase/local-fixes). They may exist on upstream-main or may need creation. Phase scope sections say 'Add or adapt' tests but validation sections present node --test commands as if files will exist.
issues.suggested_fix: When each later phase reaches its own gate, verify test file existence on the implementation branch before running validation. If absent, the phase scope should explicitly list them under 'create' rather than only 'adapt'.

issues.title: Phases 3-6 lack explicit approval gates
issues.details: Only Phases 1, 2, 7, and 8 define explicit approval gates. Phases 3-6 have validation sections but no stop-and-review step. The execution rules say 'Stop at each approval gate and report evidence' but Phases 3-6 don't define one. The Ready To Start section says 'Everything after Phase 1 requires separate approval' but this only gates Phase 2.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief note that Phases 3-6 require operator review of validation results before proceeding, or explicitly state they can execute sequentially once Phase 2 is approved.

rollback tag rollback/mase-local-fixes-pre-upstream-2026-06-02 still exists and points to ba25aa10
